mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business confidence increase.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 5% and SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals monetary easing, which typically leads to increased borrowing and investment, driving up equity prices.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS drops below 0.1% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) together indicate strong consumer demand, which should positively impact corporate earnings and equity prices over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and HOUST show growth but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 25% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) during an economic expansion signals strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive equity returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy, leading to increased consumer and business spending, which should drive up equity prices over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which should lead to increased consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 50,000 but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising retail sales (RSAFS) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates strong consumer demand and easy monetary conditions, which should boost equity prices over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and FEDFUNDS indicate positive conditions but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) during a monetary tightening cycle signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises but SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 25% of cases.
